t: Escape the Tech Churn: Why Terminal and Vim Mastery Endures
s: Mastery of the text-only terminal and Vi/Vim editor provides a foundational, future-proof skill resistant to rapid tech obsolescence, unlike ephemeral IDEs and frameworks. This enduring competence stems from text being the universal language of technology and the adaptable nature of Vi/Vim across diverse computing environments.
sub: Resistance to Tech Churn and Tool Obsolescence
Ubiquity and Adaptability of Terminal/Vi/Vim Skills
Text as the Universal Fabric of Technology
